observations.behavior: A regular universe offer starts from one generated HIGH movie package; the contract carries the actual remaining roadmap and quoted actor compensation.
observations.verificationMeaning: A franchise title by itself is not proof of an epic ensemble, unusually strong craft or very large campaign.

observations.behavior: Future commitments clone the entry project, then change title, subtype and per-film actor identity. Preparation, premieres and paid audience history still run through the normal engine.
observations.verificationMeaning: Compare actual resulting quality, cast and budgets. Do not add a gross multiplier to make a named crossover meet a target.

routingDefect.title: Godzilla vs. Kong
routingDefect.oldOutcome: Streaming-only archive with $0 gross and misleading MAJOR_FAILURE field; not a theatrical flop observation
routingDefect.cause: generateProjectDetails selected a temporary streaming studio; overwriting the owner/genre for a universe left the old route in place. Future mixed-roadmap items also inherited the entry media type.
routingDefect.fix: Explicit per-roadmap media; new movie projects THEATRICAL and actual series STREAMING_ONLY; legacy series markers supported on acceptance
